title: lyonia racemosa
intro: Lyonia racemosa, commonly known as the Fetterbush, is a flowering shrub native to the southeastern United States. This plant has been used in traditional medicine for its health benefits, including reducing inflammation, improving respiratory issues, and supporting immune function. The therapeutic actions of Lyonia racemosa include its antimicrobial, antioxidant, and anti-inflammatory properties, which contribute to its potential in treating various health conditions. The bioactive constituents of Lyonia racemosa include flavonoids, phenolic acids, and terpenoids, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
